segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from the control room, confirming conspiracy time returns despite Clementine's disappearance.

segments.title: Stream Planning & Network Rundown
segments.notes: Case Blackwell outlines the broadcast slate: kitchen stream targeted for Tuesday, new 8-hour debate marathon stretch goal set for July, and technical prep for a new conspiracy correspondent.

segments.title: Truth Zone Debut with Guy Redacted
segments.notes: Case activates Rennerton tech to introduce Guy Redacted as the network's new conspiracy analyst; Guy Redacted opens the Truth Zone desk, covers Alex Jones' Chapter 7 liquidation and Sandy Hook defamation judgment, reacts to courtroom footage, and fields a raid from Kassim G.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the live station sign-on and confirms conspiracy programming returns despite Clementine's absence.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the news desk, sets the broadcast rundown, announces an 8-hour debate marathon stretch goal, and launches the new Truth Zone conspiracy desk.

characters.name: Guy Redacted
characters.notes: conspiracy correspondent. Debuts as the network's new conspiracy analyst in the Truth Zone, wearing dark sunglasses and defending Alex Jones while dissecting his bankruptcy liquidation.

storylines.beat: Case references the Beyblade Tournament as a pending community pledge event during stream planning.
Case alludes to the Crum Punch trilogy history while setting an 8-hour debate marathon goal, noting Munch and Crum may not survive eight straight hours.

lore_notes.fact: Introduced as the network's new conspiracy correspondent, replacing the disappeared Clementine; claims to have been pulled from a 'truth cave' for a king's ransom.
Former conspiracy expert has been 'silenced' and disappeared; Case knows who silenced him but cannot find YouTube videos on it.
New stretch goal set for July; Case plans to vary debate formats beyond Munch & Crum to include presidential town halls and guest appearances.
Targeted for Tuesday pending kitchen condition and shopping; Jeb's kitchen camera setup required for his eventual cooking segment.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's station sign-on before Case Blackwell outlines a broadcast slate including a Tuesday kitchen stream and an eight-hour debate marathon stretch goal for July. The anchor then debuts Guy Redacted as the network's new conspiracy correspondent in the Truth Zone, where the dark-sunglassed analyst defends Alex Jones against the Sandy Hook families' $1.5 billion judgment and reacts to courtroom footage before a raid from Kassim G interrupts the segment.
